habitat: Singly or in pairs in reeds, dense riparian and bushveld thickets, tall rank grass and well-wooded suburbia.
summary: A common near-endemic resident. Black cap and tail, rufous wings and white underparts, with finely barred upper tail coverts. The fledgling has a whitish eyebrow, whitish streaks on the head, dark barring above and a blue-grey eye. Newman’s species page does not describe the voice. The Kemp code RB was left unchanged.

similar.note: Senegal Coucal has unbarred upper tail coverts. Newman says the ranges do not overlap. Both are on the Kruger list, and the tail-covert barring is the difference given here.

population.notes: Kemp et al. 2001 order-of-magnitude threshold 2^14=16384 mature individuals (resident breeder); paper interval half–double → 8192–32768.

sources.title: Kemp A.C., Herholdt J.J., Whyte I. & Harrison J. (2001). Birds of the two largest national parks in South Africa: a method to generate estimates of population size for all species and assess their conservation ecology. S. Afr. J. Sci. 97: 393–403.

head.pattern: Black cap. The adult eye is the crimson one contrasted with the fledgling.
Small whitish eyebrow and fine whitish streaking on the head. Eyes blue-grey, not crimson.

upperparts.pattern: Dark barring on the upper parts.

viewNotes.note: Black cap, rufous wing and white underparts, with fine barring on the upper tail coverts.
White underparts and a black cap.
Black tail and finely barred upper tail coverts. The wings are rufous.
The upperwing was named only as rufous.
White underparts. The underside of the wing was not named.

calls.description: Newman’s species page does not describe the voice. Grade A call from Grahamstown. The filename is Burchells coucal calling.mp3. Kruger files at the same grade had no catalogue type, so this typed call was kept.

research.note: Status is resident and all twelve months are listed. Newman calls it a common near-endemic resident. The adult eye is stored as red because the fledgling is contrasted with a crimson eye. Population figures were left unchanged.
